name: Key Ingredients
summary: Kreza Darkthorn needs leather and iron for a key moulding. You gather the materials while she keeps the embers hot.

sections.title: Materials for the Moulding
sections.body: Kreza Darkthorn has a worn moulding that may be used to fashion a key. You bring her four Thick Leather and twelve Iron Bar while she keeps the embers hot. The moulding should hold, and Kreza is ready to see what can be done.

faq.answer: Kreza asks you to bring four Thick Leather and twelve Iron Bar.
The materials are for fashioning a key from a crude, worn moulding.

faq.q: Who is keeping the embers hot?
faq.answer: Kreza Darkthorn says she will keep the embers hot while you gather the materials.

faq.q: What does Kreza say about the moulding?
faq.answer: Kreza says the moulding is crude and worn, but may still be used to fashion a key.
